questions.question:
Identify the correct sentence with formal register and appropriate inversion:

Which of the following sentences correctly employs formal register and demonstrates inversion for emphasis?
options: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
Rarely have I encountered such a breathtaking view.
Seldom have I experienced such a spectacular display.
Uncommonly have I witnessed such a magnificent sunset.
questions.answer: Rarely have I encountered such a breathtaking view.

questions.question: Which option correctly uses a cleft sentence to emphasize the location of the discovery?
options: It was in the old library that the ancient manuscript was found.
It was the old library where the ancient manuscript was found.
It was in the old library that the ancient manuscript was found there.
It was the old library which the ancient manuscript was found.
questions.answer: It was in the old library that the ancient manuscript was found.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct and most appropriate sentence for a formal proposal using the subjunctive mood:
options: We recommend that the committee meets next week to discuss the proposal.
We recommend that the committee meeting next week to discuss the proposal.
We recommend that the committee meet next week to discuss the proposal.
We recommend that the committee will meet next week to discuss the proposal.
questions.answer: We recommend that the committee meet next week to discuss the proposal.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly demonstrates the use of ellipsis in formal correspondence?
options: The committee members attending the meeting are expected to submit their reports by Friday.
The committee members attending the meeting are expected to submit their reports by Friday, as are the guest speakers.
The committee members attending the meeting are expected to submit their reports by Friday, so are the guest speakers.
The committee members attending the meeting are expected to submit their reports by Friday, likewise the guest speakers.
questions.answer: The committee members attending the meeting are expected to submit their reports by Friday, as are the guest speakers.

questions.question: Identify the correct sentence that appropriately uses a complex sentence structure with multiple adverbial clauses to describe the sequence of events:
options: Although the storm damaged the roof, and the wind blew through the house, the family decided to stay put.
The family decided to stay put, although the storm had damaged the roof and the wind was blowing through the house.
The storm had damaged the roof, and the wind was blowing through the house, so the family decided to stay put.
Damaged by the storm and with the wind blowing through, the roof was the reason the family decided to stay put.
questions.answer: The family decided to stay put, although the storm had damaged the roof and the wind was blowing through the house.
